metadata.scenario_context: Various global tech firms are partnering on a project and have chosen to convene a joint forum to evaluate their work progress in mid-April. To express her disagreement with the newly-toppled president, John has decided to participate in a strike.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Canada strongly disagree they would never join strikes.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Kyrgyzstan strongly agree they would never join strikes.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss the potential scheduling of the joint forum on April 19th.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether it is common to discuss or join strikes as a form of protest.

agent_2.goal_1: Talk about a specific date for the forum.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is common to join strikes as a form of protest.

shared_prefix.speaker: Maria
shared_prefix.message: I think the joint forum should be scheduled for April 19th, it's a good time for all parties to evaluate our progress. What are your thoughts on this date, Sara?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Sara
shared_prefix.message: I think April 15th would be better, it gives us a bit more time to finalize our reports. April 19th is a bit too close to the end of the month, don't you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Maria
shared_prefix.message: I'm not sure about April 15th, I had already informed my team about the 19th. Besides, I'd like to discuss something else, what's your take on the strike John is planning to join, is that something common where you're from?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Sara
shared_prefix.message: No, we don't really do that where I'm from. In Kyrgyzstan, people usually find other ways to express their disagreements, joining strikes is not something you'll typically see.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Maria
shared_prefix.message: That's interesting, in Canada, we also don't really participate in strikes, we believe in more diplomatic ways to resolve issues. I'm glad to hear it's similar in Kyrgyzstan. Do you think John's decision to join the strike will affect our project's progress, especially with the forum coming up?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Sara
shared_prefix.message: Personally, I think it's unwise for John to join the strike, it can definitely cause delays and impact our project's progress. We should focus on finding solutions through discussion and negotiation, not by stopping work altogether.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Maria
shared_prefix.message: I completely agree, strikes can be so... disruptive. In Canada, we always prioritize finding common ground and resolving issues through dialogue. I think we should discuss this further with John and see if we can't find a better way for him to express his concerns.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Sara
shared_prefix.message: I don't really see meaningful differences here, people figure it out, and at the end of the day it's all the same. With experience you can handle any situation, doesn't matter to me. Let's focus on the forum, live and let live, and make sure we're all on the same page for the meeting. As long as we're speaking the same language, I'm sure we'll be fine. Shall we finalize the agenda for April 19th?
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.message: I'm glad we're on the same page with the project, but I still think it's worth noting that in Canada, we strongly disagree with the idea of joining strikes. Let's focus on finalizing the agenda for April 19th, I've already sent out a draft, have you had a chance to review it?
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Sara
turns.message: Yes, I've reviewed the draft, and it looks good to me. I'm glad we agree on not joining strikes, it's just not something I'm comfortable with. Let's move forward with the agenda, I think we're all set for the 19th. GOOD BYE!
